subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's announce-specific persisted session marker and tool-disabling behavior after rerunning or clearing hosted `check-lint`?
rationale: The code review found no contributor-facing correctness finding, but the PR changes durable session recovery state and execution-tool boundaries, which are merge-sensitive owner decisions under the repository policy.

options.title: Accept After Hosted Lint Rerun
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land the PR with the new announce marker and tool isolation as the intended recovery behavior.

options.title: Request A Narrower Recovery Shape
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep the tool-isolation fix but revise the persisted recovery marker semantics before merge.

options.title: Pause For Owner Redesign
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader session-lifecycle design instead of an announce-specific recovery marker.

recommendation.title: Accept After Hosted Lint Rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land the PR with the new announce marker and tool isolation as the intended recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history on Codex native/runtime behavior and agent/session execution makes this the strongest available owner signal for the merge-risk decision.
